title: The Grateful Dead Live at Meadowlands Arena on 1984-10-17
source: Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell XLII-S C-90)  Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 24-bit/96KHz) > Soundforge 9.0 (edits) > flac24

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording of an energetic 1984 show with strong setlists.
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the band for being on fire and calls the set lists awesome, while noting that the audio—though not a soundboard source—is still pretty good. Overall it’s considered an enjoyable listening experience despite the non‑soundboard recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review highlights a strong performance and decent audio quality, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity; not a soundboard (no SBD) but still fairly clear with typical audience ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlists described as awesome, indicating an engaging and well‑crafted flow.
